areas.name: Jasper National Park
areas.notes: AB curation 2026-11-02. Whole park. Compared with the Parks Canada Jasper day-hike pages (https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/experience/sentiers-trails). Kept: backcountry trails (Skyline, Tonquin Valley, Fryatt, Brazeau, Maligne Pass, Jonas Pass, Poboktan, Snake Indian Falls, Overlander), day hikes (Cavell Meadows, Edith Cavell Pond, Opal Hills, Maligne Canyon, Sulphur Skyline, Pyramid, Whistlers, Wilcox Pass, Mary Schaeffer Loop, Valley of the Five Lakes) and named scrambles. Excluded: the numbered Jasper town MTB/fitness trail network (Trail N, Sidewinder, Swamp Rider...), informal climbing paths, boundary-clipped stubs, alt/duplicate pieces; Great Divide Trail dropped by the Canada filter as long-distance. Remediation (review #704): hiking trails Wabasso, Mina, Curator, Saturday Night, High Lakes, Minnow, Stutfield Ice Cave, Cinquifoil, Morrow reinstated and renamed; Edith Cavell Pond Trail composite excluded. live-fix1 2026-11-02: pin moved from [52.804, -117.634] (3.37 mi from the nearest trail) to a trail point next to the trail-extent midpoint. live-fix1 remediation (review #717): restored The Whistlers Summit Trail, Pyramid Mountain Trail (agency-listed or only link to a listed trail).

Compared with the Parks Canada Waterton trail table (https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/waterton/activ/experiences/randonee-hiking): Bear's Hump, Bertha Lake, Crypt Lake, Crandell Lake, Blakiston Falls, Carthew/Alderson legs, Lineham Creek, Rowe Lakes, Twin Lakes, Wishbone, Tamarack, Vimy Peak, Avion Ridge, Linnet Lake and Townsite Loop are present. Red Rock Canyon (0.7 km loop) kept by waiver. Snowshoe (winter only), horse bypasses and clipped stubs excluded. Akamina Lake, Lower Rowe Lake and Cameron Lakeshore not shipped (stub/unmapped). Crypt Lake Trail is left to the live US Waterton areas (duplicate gate); known omission here. live-fix1 2026-11-02: added Crypt Lake (whole 6.2 mi in Waterton; its 0.33 mi clipped stub in the US area waterton-lakes-national-park-mt is not touched and should be retired by the US owner) and Snowshoe; Carthew-Alderson, Lakeshore, Blakiston Valley and Boundary Creek have no named way in OSM; Akamina Pass is boundary-clipped (0.9 of 1.6 mi inside). Peak and route items dropped.

No registry-only route: OSM has no hiking relation for the named trails, only name-stitched ways (Garibaldi Lake Trail 13 ways / 5.8 mi but 1.3 mi assembles, Singing Pass Trail 7.3 mi and Taylor Meadows 2.0 mi are absent from the replay), so Black Tusk, Garibaldi Lake, Panorama Ridge and Elfin Lakes stay stubs. Still HOLD; needs OSM relations or an engine stitch rule.

areas.name: Prince Albert National Park
areas.notes: SK/MB curation 2026-11-02. Whole park. Compared with the Parks Canada PANP trail list (https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/activ/experiences/randonee-hiking/etat-sentiers-trail-conditions): Amyot Lake, Boundary Bog, Freight Tait Springs, Mud Creek, Narrows Peninsula, Red Deer (Blue, Red, Yellow loops), Shady Lake, Spruce River Highland, Stoney Plain Meadow Spur, Valleyview (Difficult, Easy, Moderate loops) and Waskesiu River Trail present. The 20 km Grey Owl Trail is mapped in OSM as five campsite-to-campsite legs (11.8 mi); two legs carry the word Portage and are waived, all five are labelled Grey Owl Trail: <leg>. Kingsmere River to Northend Campsite (0.87 mi) kept as OSM labels it. Known omissions (no named OSM way): Elk Trail, Fisher Trail, Treebeard Trail, Hunters Trail, Height of Land Tower, Valleyview Lookout; Kingsmere River Trail is only the 0.87 mi leg. Canoe portages (Kingsmere - Clare Lake, Lily - Clare Lake) dropped by the engine. live-fix1 2026-11-02: the five Grey Owl Trail campsite legs and the Kingsmere River connector dropped as stage legs. The Grey Owl Trail itself needs a merge of its legs or one OSM relation (follow-up). live-fix1 2026-11-02: pin moved from [53.897, -106.366] (6.64 mi from the nearest trail) to a trail point next to the trail-extent midpoint. live-fix1 remediation (review #717): the five Grey Owl Trail legs restored until a merged Grey Owl Trail exists.

areas.name: Refuge d’oiseaux migrateurs du Mont-Saint-Hilaire
areas.notes: ca-new3 2026-11-02: SHIP. Gault Nature Reserve (McGill), Mont-Saint-Hilaire. Boundary = relation r20631839 (Mont-Saint-Hilaire Migratory Bird Sanctuary), a one-member relation whose outer way w475531260 is the Gault polygon; the reserve's own relation r12244795 is a 0.005 deg fragment (fails the size gate) and its way twin hits the name-collision refusal. display_name gives locals the name they use. Replay 7 trails / 11.8 mi: Rocky (Rouge), Rocky (Bleu), Dieppe (Vert), Pain de Sucre (Jaune), Burning Hill (Orange), Mauve, Lac Hertel. The AllTrails five-summit loop (Burned Hill, Pain de Sucre, Dieppe, Rocky, Saint-Hilaire) and Lac Hertel match; official Gault trail page (https://gault.mcgill.ca/en/outdoor-activities/) was only seen as a search snippet, not read. Sentier du Piedmont (1.5 mi) lies in the neighbouring Piémont reserve and is not included. Gault is visitor-capped and fee-based; the trails are public-by-reservation.
